**Finding submitted: deviation (LOL-CAP), fallback-level cure.**

- **What exists:** Paragraph 21 is the whole liability architecture — 21.1 (several, not joint), 21.2 (mutual third-party indemnity capped at each Party's Schedule B share), 21.3 (mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential loss and lost profits/traffic/business). Paragraphs 4.9/warranty disclaimer (p0126–p0127) and Paragraph 32 (claims reimbursement) add no cap. Searches for "aggregate liability", "exceed", "gross negligence"/"wilful misconduct" returned nothing.
- **Why it fails fallback:** no aggregate monetary cap at all (our direct exposure is unlimited, reciprocally) and no uncapped carve-outs. The mutual indirect-damages exclusion is a preferred-only element and was left verbatim.
- **Cure:** one new Subparagraph 21.4 inserted after p0245 — a mutual 12-month cap keyed to this contract's actual payment stream (defined **Capital Costs** and **O&M Costs**, since there is no "fees" concept here), with indemnification, Paragraph 31 confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap. No USD 1,000,000 floor, data-protection, fraud or IP carve-outs volunteered, and no rewrite of neighbouring text.
